where: #kutuphaneler-telefon 'durum değişimleri CSS tarzı geçişlerle yazılır' vs #hareket Yaylar 'efekt ... Renk ve opaklık (telefon)' and Kurallar 08 'renk ve opaklık yay efekt ya da süre tokenı ile'
problem: Two drivers for the same phone patterns, never resolved per component. Kütüphaneler: press, color, visibility use Reanimated CSS-style transitions with cubic-bezier tokens. Yaylar: color/opacity use spring efekt (272 ms); tab indicator and press release use spring hizli (282 ms) while #etkilesim 'tab' (both platforms) says 'gösterge uzun 240 ms', standart, and 'press' releases in mikro 100 ms; toast and list move use spring orta (384 ms) while #etkilesim gives toast 'giriş orta 200 ms ... giris / cikis' and list 'yer değişimi uzun 240 ms'. Kurallar 08 says 'ya da'. Kütüphaneler 'Basma geri bildirimi' adds a third press duration: '100 ile 150 ms'. The motion helpers cannot be written without guessing.
fix: Add a 'Telefon' column to #etkilesim naming exactly one driver per pattern (CSS-style transition dur+ease, withTiming, or withSpring name); delete the spring usage lines that disagree; replace '100 ile 150 ms' with 'mikro 100 ms'; remove 'ya da' from Kurallar 08.

where: #kutuphaneler-panel 'Yazı tipi barındırma' 'kullanılacak: 5.3.0 (Inter için, tam sabit)'; #kutuphaneler-telefon 'Yazı tipi' Risk 'Aile tipografi kararında seçilecek'
problem: The panel font row still installs @fontsource-variable/inter although #tipografi chose IBM Plex Sans; the phone row says the family is still to be chosen; (l) in Çözülen çelişkiler keeps '<aile>' placeholders. No package is named for Plex Mono on the panel (the page embeds static @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 400/500, so 'panelde değişken WOFF2' is false for Mono). The phone TTF list is never given: Sans 400/500/600/700, Mono 400/500 plus 600/700 for Kalın Metin (400 to 600, 500 to 700), from which IBM release, with which subset command.
fix: Panel: '@fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans 5.3.0 + @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.3.0 (400, 500, 600, 700)'. Phone: exact TTF file list, IBM Plex release tag, pyftsubset command (unicodes + '--layout-features-=liga'). Delete the Inter example, the '<aile>' placeholders and the stale 'seçilecek' risk.

where: #kutuphaneler, whole section: 'Önce beş araştırmacı ayrı alanlara baktı'; table column 'Ölçüm, 6 Ekim 2026'
problem: This is the largest section of the repository design document: 8,451 of 29,224 words (28.9%) and 21,196 of 95,405 px at 1440. Most of it is research output: weekly downloads, stars and issue-closing days, 'Yedek ve elenenler' package histories, the narrative about five researchers and a critic, and 'Çözülen çelişkiler (a) to (l)' set in 12 px gray paragraphs. The owner's rule keeps research out of the repository and rejects length that carries no decision. Screens: out\review1\tiles\1440-kutuphaneler-t03.png, out\review1\crop-kut-b.png.
fix: Keep one table per platform with only 'Konu | Seçim | sürüm | one-sentence reason', about 600 words. Move these to tasarim-arastirmasi.html under L1 to L5 and link them: the Ölçüm, Risk and 'Yedek ve elenenler' cells, paragraphs 2 to 5 of 'Nasıl seçildi', 'Tabloları okuma' and 'Çözülen çelişkiler'.

where: #kutuphaneler .lib-table first column, e.g. 'Animasyon motoru'
problem: Row headers have 0 padding while other cells have 16 px, so 'Konu' and the row labels touch the table's left border. Package chips also break inside the name ('react-native-' then 'reanimated'), and each fragment gets its own gray box. Screen: out\review1\zoom-libtable.png.
fix: Set th[scope=row] { padding: 16px }, and set white-space: nowrap on package-name chips.

where: #kaynaklar and #kutuphaneler link text, e.g. 'Wikipedia, Wikipedia, Wikipedia, Wikipedia'
problem: There are 413 external links. 'registry.npmjs.org' is the link text 52 times and 'raw.githubusercontent.com' 23 times. 'docs.swmansion.com' twice and 'sheet.lodev09.com' three times sit side by side. Identical labels lead to different pages (WCAG 2.4.4). The link colour makes #kaynaklar the bluest block in the document: 3.52% midnight-blue pixels against a 0.44% page average. Screen: out\review1\tiles\1440-kaynaklar-t00.png.
fix: Name each link by its page title and use one link per claim. Move registry and raw-file links to the research file.

where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli table, row 'Grafik': 'oranlar meter ve düz SVG ile çizilir.'
problem: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari all paint the native <meter> green for the optimum value and yellow for the suboptimum value, and accent-color does not affect it. Following this row puts green and yellow into the panel's devam oranları (Y4), which the owner banned ('kesinlikle olmayacak'). dgate.js and tcheck.js cannot catch it, because the colour comes from the browser's own stylesheet.
fix: Use the doc's existing 4 px bar instead (a div with role='meter' and aria-valuenow/min/max, accent.11 on neutral.4) and add '<meter> kullanılmaz' to #renk. If <meter> stays, specify appearance: none and set ::-webkit-meter-bar, ::-webkit-meter-optimum-value, ::-webkit-meter-suboptimum-value, ::-webkit-meter-even-less-good-value and ::-moz-meter-bar each to a token.

where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli row 'Yazı tipi barındırma': 'kullanılacak: 5.3.0 (Inter için, tam sabit)'; Telefon row 'Yazı tipi', Risk: 'Aile tipografi kararında seçilecek'

Delete 'örnek: @fontsource-variable/inter', 'Inter için' and 'Aile tipografi kararında seçilecek'.

where: #kutuphaneler, Web paneli row 'Tarih seçici': 'bu, uygulamanın telefon ve tarayıcı ayarını izlediği plan kararıyla uyumlu.'
problem: plan.html#hoca says 'Panel Türkçe dil ve Türkçe biçimle çalışır'. Its 'follow the browser settings' decision covers text size and contrast, not date format. A US-English browser shows 10/06/2026, which contradicts the plan, and #acik 05 of this same document says exactly that. The row misstates plan.html (D11 requires no contradiction with the plan).
fix: Replace with: 'Görünen biçim tarayıcının dilinden gelir; bu, planın Türkçe biçim kararıyla çelişir (bkz. Açık noktalar 05).'

where: #kutuphaneler 'Çözülen çelişkiler' (d): 'sonner 2.0.8, bildir() sarmalayıcısının arkasında; yedek Base UI Toast.'
problem: Item (d) gives Sonner as the resolution ('Yerel öğe kararına bu tek istisna'). The Web paneli 'Bildirim (toast)' row says no library. The closing paragraph overturns (d) ('Sonner yerine tarayıcının canlı bölgesi Üç kör eleştirmenden ikisi...', with no punctuation after 'bölgesi'). #acik 04 asks the owner. That is three answers in one section, plus remarks about blind critics in a repository document.
fix: Delete (d), the sentence 'Kararı bozan tek öneri sonner' and the closing 'Panel bildirimi' paragraph. Keep the table row and #acik 04 as the only statement.

where: #kutuphaneler 'Nasıl seçildi' ('dört ölçüt · beş araştırma · bir eleştirmen'), 'Tek bakışta', 'Bilerek kullanılmayanlar', 'Tabloları okuma', 'Çözülen çelişkiler'
problem: The section is 8,654 words, 30% of the document. About 2,300 of them are build history or restatements of the tables. They cover who researched it ('beş araştırmacı', 'bir eleştirmen', 'Üç kör eleştirmen') and how the numbers were fetched ('elle yazılmadı', 3 times). They include a summary of the tables that sit right below it, and a rejected list that repeats each row's elenenler cell: Tailwind with Firefox 128 appears 4 times, sonner #355 5 times, Moti twice. Twelve 'çözülen çelişkiler' items either restate rows ((a), (b), (e), (h), (i), (k), (l)) or contradict them ((d)). Research history belongs in the research file.
fix: Keep the three tables and one sentence on the selection criteria, with a link to the research file's Kütüphaneler section. Move 'Nasıl seçildi' paragraphs 2 to 4, 'Tek bakışta', 'Bilerek kullanılmayanlar', 'Tabloları okuma' and 'Çözülen çelişkiler' into tasarim-arastirmasi.html. This cuts about 2,300 words.

where: #kutuphaneler tables: 'Ölçüm, 6 Ekim 2026' column and the link lists
